exito: Mission complete! Your spacecraft reached {destino} and every resource stayed above its minimum, with mass, power and cost in balance. Try another design: there is more than one way to succeed.
delta_v_insuficiente: The mission stopped: this trip needs {dv_requerido_m_s} m/s of delta-v, but your spacecraft only has {dv_disponible_m_s} m/s. Delta-v is the total change in velocity the engines can deliver, and it depends on propellant mass and specific impulse (Isp). Try giving more budget to propulsion.
potencia_insuficiente: The mission stopped: your spacecraft needs {consumo_w} W but its power system only delivers {generada_w} W. Sunlight gets weaker with distance from the Sun, so distant missions need larger solar arrays or another power source. Try giving more budget to power.
masa_excede_lanzador: The launch was cancelled: your spacecraft has a mass of {m0_kg} kg and the {lanzador} can lift {capacidad_kg} kg to this destination. Propellant adds a lot of mass, and a heavier spacecraft needs a more capable launch vehicle. Try less propellant, a lighter spacecraft or another launch vehicle.
presupuesto_excedido: The mission stopped before launch: it costs {costo_musd} M USD and your budget is {presupuesto_musd} M USD. Launch vehicle, spacecraft and instruments all add to the bill. Check which part costs the most and try a cheaper option.
falla_aleatoria: Your design met every limit, but an unexpected failure hit the mission. Real missions face surprises too, which is why engineers keep design margins. Try again with more margin, or fly the same design once more.
explota: The spacecraft broke apart during launch: its structure is {valor} {unidad} and it needs at least {minimo} {unidad} to survive the launch loads and vibration. The structure is the frame that holds everything together. Try giving more budget to the structure.
incomunicada: The mission stopped: your link sends only {valor} {unidad} and it needs at least {minimo} {unidad} to reach Earth. A weak antenna cannot send data from far away. Try giving more budget to communications.
sin_ciencia: The mission stopped: your science instruments total {valor} {unidad} and the objective needs at least {minimo} {unidad}. Arriving is not enough if the science cannot be done. Try giving more budget to the science instruments.
fuera_de_tiempo: The mission stopped: the spacecraft can operate for only {valor} {unidad} and the mission plan needs at least {minimo} {unidad}. Endurance limits how long a mission can last. Try giving more budget to endurance.
